question: Admit an existing public RNA/direct-function comparison only at its documented experimental-unit and biological-system scope.
forbidden_inferences: match assays by row order or local replicate ordinals
infer a donor or treatment from expression
count cells or wells as additional donors
infer functional benefit from RNA, protein abundance or an age-clock change alone
join different doses, times or rescue arms without documented compatibility
infer same-cell continuity from destructive assays
equate a functional phenotype with reversal of biological aging

ranking.interpretation: A reproducible research acquisition order, not an efficacy or safety score. Human-reviewed priority inputs and their rationale remain explicit.

stop_rule: Finish after eight named candidates and their linked public source records/supplements. Preserve unresolved fields and choose the narrowest supported next comparison.
claim_limits: No new expression contrasts or RNA/function correlations in this packet
No clinical, safety, rejuvenation or wet-lab replacement conclusion
Phase 483 and all prior controller verdicts remain unchanged
